Meet Gbemisola

Cooking from the heart, served with elegance

For Gbemisola, food has always been about bringing people together. What began as a love of cooking for family and friends has grown into Gbemisola Catering — an independent UK catering business built on warmth, generosity and a genuine passion for beautiful food.

Every occasion starts with a conversation. Gbemisola takes the time to understand your celebration, your guests and the flavours you love, then designs a menu that feels personal — never off-the-shelf. From the first canapé to the final course, each dish is prepared fresh, seasoned with care and presented to be remembered.

Quality ingredients sit at the heart of everything: seasonal produce, thoughtfully sourced, prepared from scratch and served with pride. It is catering with a personal touch — the kind your guests talk about long after the day itself.

  • Menus designed around you
  • Fresh, seasonal ingredients
  • Prepared from scratch
  • A personal, friendly service

— Gbemisola

Why Choose Us

The Gbemisola difference

Great catering is never just about the food. It is about trust, care and the feeling your guests take home with them.

01

Fresh Ingredients

Seasonal produce, chosen with care and prepared from scratch — because food made fresh simply tastes better.

02

Personalised Menus

No two celebrations are alike, so no two menus are either. Yours is designed around your occasion, tastes and guests.

03

Attention to Detail

From the seasoning to the styling of the table, the little things are looked after — so the whole day feels effortless.

04

Reliable Service

Clear communication, calm organisation and food that arrives when promised. You can relax and enjoy your own event.
